planets.name: TOI-530 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-530 with a 6.39-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-530 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-530. Its orbit and size follow Gan et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
